messages.content: One fingerprint, 14 reports. Let me read one and check the code and the issue tracker.
Issue #104 looks like this same crash. I'll read it and the code at the crash site.
`Stop` closes `d.stop` with no guard, so a second call panics. Before choosing a fix, I'll check the struct and every place that touches `stop`.
The cause is clear: `Stop` closes the channel on every call, and nothing guards a second call. I'll check how existing notify tests build a dispatcher so my reproducer matches them.
I'll write the reproducer first: it calls `Stop` twice and must not panic. Then I'll confirm it fails on the current code.

function.arguments: {"id": 104, "body": "Root cause: notify/notify.go, (*Dispatcher).Stop calls close(d.stop) unconditionally, so a second call panics with \"close of closed channel\". The admin endpoint POST /v1/admin/dispatcher/stop (api/admin.go stopDispatcher) reaches it on every call. Reports: 14 crashes under fingerprint fp_2bcd17, all v1.4.0 (commit 9c41e7a).\n\nFix: Dispatcher gets a sync.Once (stopOnce) and Stop closes the channel inside stopOnce.Do, so repeated calls are no-ops. Reproducer: notify/stop_test.go TestStopTwice, which fails on the old code and passes with the fix. Full test suite passes."}
